'''Chapter 1037''' is titled "Shuron Hakke".

==Cover Page==
[[Germa 66's Ahh... An Emotionless Excursion]], Vol. 2: "Judge Sighs"

[[Vinsmoke Judge]] sighs as he looks over a balcony with [[Vinsmoke Reiju|Reiju]] and [[Vinsmoke Ichiji|Ichiji]].

==Short Summary==
As [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Kaidou]]'s battle rages on, the latter gets drunk on [[Foods/Beverages#Rice Brew ("Sake")|sake]] and goes through a wide range of emotions and quick mood swings. Meanwhile, the [[Five Elders]] are discussing the [[Raid on Onigashima|Wano conflict]] on [[Mary Geoise]] when they receive a report from one of the [[Ship#Government Ships|government ships]] stationed nearby that [[Zunesha]] has arrived. As they hear the report, the Elders turn the discussion to a legendary [[Devil Fruit]] that seemingly had not awakened in centuries; however, one Elder points out that the fruit had specifically been given a different kind of name, likely for the purpose of erasing it from [[World Timeline|history]].

==Long Summary==
The [[Fire Festival]] in the [[Flower Capital]] starts coming to a close, with several people writing wishes onto Sky Ships to set afloat in the sky.

Little do the people actually know, [[Onigashima]] is still making its way to the capital, and up on the roof of the [[Skull Dome]], [[Kaidou]] has returned to his human form and started drinking, much to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]’s annoyance. Kaidou tells Luffy that he’s drinking because he’s having fun and reminds him of the banquet they were originally having before they ruined it. After Kaidou finishes drinking, he goes into '''[[Shuron Hakke#Techniques|Warai Jogo]]''' mode, and Luffy, while still annoyed, charges at him hoping he doesn’t use getting drunk as an excuse if he loses. Kaidou, however, clarifies that he drank because it will make him stronger, as he has finally acknowledged his power.

In his drunken state, Kaidou dodges an attack from Luffy and counters with '''[[Shuron Hakke]]''' and [[Hassaikai#Techniques|'''Warai Jogo: Ragnaraku''']], changing back into his Human-Beast Form and slamming Luffy into the ground, with chunks of roof falling onto the people still inside the castle. Luffy clutches his head in pain as Kaidou becomes a [[Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu|dragon]] and also goes into '''Ochikomi Jogo''' mode, lamenting how half the castle and island are destroyed because of his inability to protect it, and how it may take another five years to rebuild everything. Luffy charges at him again but Kaidou uses '''Tatsumaki Kaifu''' to blow him back, just as he goes into his Human-Beast Form and '''Naki Jogo''' mode and attacks Luffy with '''Raimei Hakke''', but Luffy dodges it and kicks him square in the face with a [[Haki/Supreme King Haki#Infusion|Supreme King Haki-coated]] foot.

Though he draws blood, Kaidou suddenly grabs Luffy with his tail and brings him forward to his face as they both headbutt each other with Supreme King Haki, but Luffy is overwhelmed and blown back as he admits Kaidou’s [[Haki]] is growing stronger. Kaidou then goes into '''Okori Jogo''' mode and gets mad at Luffy for starting to sober him up and fires a blast of energy at him, but Luffy dodges, and he charges at him with '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 3 Techniques#Post-Timeskip|Gomu Gomu no Roc Gatling]]''' while Kaidou counters with '''Gundari Ryuseigun'''. Both attacks clash and both Luffy and Kaidou do get hit by each other's attacks, but Luffy manages to strike Kaidou square in the stomach.

In the Holy Land [[Mary Geoise]], the [[Five Elders]] complain about the [[Levely]] but change topics to the [[Raid on Onigashima|battle]] in [[Wano Country|Wano]] and how [[Nico Robin]] should have been captured or killed at this time, and how they need to act now. Surrounding Wano, the [[Ship#Government Ships|World Government ships]] see a giant shadow with some believing it to be an island. As it turns out, it is the [[Animal Species/Whole Cake Island Saga#Naitamie-Norida Elephant|giant elephant]] [[Zunesha]] that carries the [[Mink Tribe|mink]]'s [[Zou|island home]]. This concerns the Five Elders as according to them, “[[Gomu Gomu no Mi|that]]” [[Devil Fruit]] hasn’t awakened in centuries and should only be a legend, as one of them points out that the [[World Government]] gave it a specific name to hide its existence from the annals of [[World Timeline|history]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Vinsmoke Family|Vinsmoke]] [[Vinsmoke Judge|Judge]], [[Vinsmoke Reiju|Reiju]] and [[Vinsmoke Ichiji|Ichiji]] are shown to have survived.
*The [[Fire Festival]] is nearing its end.
*The fight between [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Kaidou]] continues.
**Kaidou drinks some [[Foods/Beverages#Alcohol|alcohol]] that affects his [[Shuron Hakke|mood and behavior, and makes his attack patterns unpredictable]] to Luffy.
*The [[Five Elders]] are having a discussion about the [[Wano Country|Wano]] [[Raid on Onigashima|war]] at [[Mary Geoise]].
**The [[World Government]] is revealed to have changed the name of a [[Gomu Gomu no Mi|Devil Fruit]] in order to hide its true name.
***The fruit has not awakened for centuries, becoming a mere legend.
*[[Zunesha]] arrives at Wano Country from behind the [[Ship#Government Ships|World Government's ships]].
